data.explanation: This is your annual settlement of operating costs (utilities/building costs) for your flat. Because your actual share (€2,183.18) was higher than what you already prepaid (€1,920.00), you owe the landlord an extra €263.18. You must pay this within 30 days of receiving the letter — the app will show the exact deadline. Check the attached itemised breakdown (Einzelaufstellung) for errors; if something looks wrong you can raise it with the landlord. If you don't pay in time, the landlord could pursue the arrears, possibly with reminders or legal steps.
